label: Center City in 3D, the walk drawn through it
alt: A 3D map of Center City Philadelphia with an orange walking route winding between the towers and hand-drawn speech bubbles along it.

label: City Hall to Rittenhouse Square, 22 minutes instead of 14
alt: A pale street map of Center City with the scenic route in orange from City Hall to Rittenhouse Square and three callouts along it.

label: A callout at the City Hall fountain
alt: A close detail of the route map: a hand-drawn speech bubble reading City Hall Fountain sits beside a few street trees, a quiet pause, with a yellow pin.

label: Every ski area within three hours of New York or Philadelphia
alt: A grey relief of the region between New York and Philadelphia with numbered circles for the ski areas, sized by their beginner terrain.

label: Belleayre in 3D, its longest green run in black
alt: A 3D view of Belleayre's hillshade with its trails drawn over it, the beginner runs in orange and one run highlighted in black.

label: Belleayre's slopes close up: bunny hill solid, green trails dotted
alt: A close 3D view of Belleayre's hillshade with the bunny hill drawn solid in orange, the green trails dotted and the lifts dashed.

label: The campus from above, along the river
alt: An aerial line drawing of a riverside campus, white buildings among pale green trees, with the existing city drawn in outline around it.

label: Student housing, exploded floor by floor
alt: An exploded axonometric of a student housing block on a pink background, its floors lifted apart with tall pines growing through them.

label: Inside the atrium, around the trunks
alt: An atrium where tall tree trunks rise through open floors, with people at tables below.

label: The street in winter
alt: A snowy street between brick housing blocks, bare trees overhead and lit windows.

label: Where AI gets built: 1,472 data centers and 77 AI campuses
alt: A dark map of the United States with small blue dots for data centers, amber dots for AI campuses running and glowing pink dots for campuses coming.

label: What AI drinks: the campuses over water stress
alt: The same campuses over teal basins shaded by water stress, densest in Texas and the Southwest.

label: Texas and the Gulf, close up
alt: A close detail of the dark map around Texas and Louisiana with large glowing pink campus dots.

label: What San Francisco lets you build
alt: San Francisco's blocks coloured by zoning: blue one-family houses across the west, red and purple industry and mixed use along the bay.

label: Philadelphia passes the 10-minute test
alt: Philadelphia's streets in orange where they are more than ten minutes from a large park, with the most heat-vulnerable tracts outlined in black.

label: What Billy Penn can no longer see
alt: A dark map of Philadelphia with pink wedges fanning out from City Hall, one for each tower that blocks the statue's view.

label: Hurricane Point on the Big Sur course
alt: Fine grey contour lines of the Big Sur coast with the marathon course in red around Hurricane Point.
